**v1.10.0: the bot's window and Wizard101 can go to the tray instead of closing - two new settings, both off.**
- **The bot's window in the tray** (`traybot`, off by default; new, and not tried in the game yet). Switch it on in Settings > THE MOUSE AND WAITS, "Put the bot's window in the tray". Then the dashboard's X (Alt+F4 in it too) and its minimize button put it in the tray instead of stopping the bot - the bot plays on. Double-click the tray icon (the tray menu's new "Show the bot's window") or press Windows+2 to bring it back; while it's on, that double-click no longer switches walking on/off. The tray menu's "Exit" (or Windows+Esc) stops the bot, and a tray tip says so the first time. Off: the X stops the bot, as before.
- **Wizard101 in the tray** (`traygame`, off by default; new, and not tried in the game yet). Settings > THE MOUSE AND WAITS, "Put Wizard101 in the tray". Then Alt+F4 with Wizard101 in front, a click on its own X and its minimize button hide its window in the tray - the game keeps running, its taskbar button goes, and nothing is sent into it. The X and minimize only when it's windowed (a title bar): a borderless or exclusive full screen game minimizes as ever. The tray menu's new "Show Wizard101" brings it back to the front. It also comes back by itself, without taking the focus (minimized if it was), when you switch the setting off, when the bot closes (Windows+Esc, Exit, a restart, an update), and - if the bot ended without that (End task, a crash) - at the bot's next start or from the "Open with Wizard101" watcher.
- **The bot is off while Wizard101 is in the tray.** Sending it there lets go of every key and switches the bot off as F6 does - each round and walking stop, and a click or key press it had under way is dropped, never sent to another window - and brings the bot back on once the game is back, if it was on. Meanwhile the bot can't be switched on, and the tray menu's "Buy potions now", "Record potion buying..." and quick sell say "show Wizard101 first"; nothing brings the game forward by itself, and the dashboard says "Wizard101 is in the tray". It isn't sent there - a tray tip says why - with two Wizard101 windows open, while auto-reconnect is getting it back online, or during a potion run, potion recording or quick sell you started. If the game closes while hidden, the bot sees it closed as ever. A restart (Windows+1) or an update while it's in the tray shows it again and starts the bot off: F6 starts it.
- **What can't be caught** still really closes the game, as before: the taskbar's "Close window", the X on a taskbar thumbnail or in Alt+Tab, Close in the window's own menu (Alt+Space), Task Manager and the game's own Quit. A click on its X while the bot is too busy to check it in time closes it too. With these on, minimizing every window (Windows+M) sends the dashboard and a windowed Wizard101 to the tray too.
- **Not tried in the game yet.** The bot's side was only read, not run (no AutoHotkey or Windows where it was made). AutoFarmer\LIVE_CHECKS.txt step 3.12 says what to try - each way in and out, Alt+F4 in the middle of a battle round, the bot closing and starting again with the game in the tray, two game windows - and what to send. memclicks is now step 3.13, still last.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
